SEALED_ROW_TITLE: Waiting for the key that opens this one
SEALED_ROW_NOTE: This console can see that a tab was sent, not what it was. The key comes from another paired device.
introCopy.title: Tabsend web console
introCopy.what: Tabsend sends a web page from one of your devices to another, such as from your computer to your phone. The console is a web page that lists your devices and shows what you sent. It can't send tabs itself. Use the Tabsend browser extension or phone app for that.
introCopy.newHereSentence: New to Tabsend? Learn more at tabsend.org.
introCopy.pairBody: Open Tabsend on a device you already use, choose Add a device, and paste its setup link here.
introCopy.privacy: Tabsend encrypts what you send on your devices. The server holds no key to read it, and the console never opens tabs.
projectLinks/app.tabsend.org: tabsend.org -> https://tabsend.org | Privacy -> https://tabsend.org/privacy | Terms -> https://tabsend.org/terms | Support -> https://tabsend.org/support
